info.title: Stacks
info.description: The Stacks API: track movies, shows, anime and Asian dramas. Every operation, schema and status here is derived from the types the server runs on. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents.

get.summary: List the caller's library.

entries changed (the default), were added, by title or by score. With
`deleted=true`, lists the trash instead.

parameters.name: favourite
parameters.description: Only favourites (`true`), or only the rest (`false`).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Only titles whose title, original title or romaji title contains this
text, ignoring case.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The `next_cursor` of the previous page. Omit for the first page. A
cursor only continues the listing (filters and order) it came from.

post.summary: Log plays of a movie or of a show's episodes.
post.description:
Tracks the title (as `watching`) when it is not in the library; a movie
play completes it. `episodes` logs one play of each listed episode;
`through` marks every episode of the current run not yet watched, from
season 1 episode 1 up to and including the one given. All the plays are
one change: either every one is logged or none is.

secret.description:

Category.description:

genre.

rewatching.description: Whether the caller is on a rewatch.

ref.description: The title's reference, which every title-scoped operation takes.

original_title.description: The original-language title, when it differs from `title`.

year.description: The release year, or the first-air year of a show.

rating.description: The provider's rating out of 10, when it has one.

library.description: `null` when the title is not in the caller's library.

TitleSummary.description: A title, as listings show it.

Degradation.description: One provider call that failed while a listing was assembled.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.

degraded.description: The provider calls that failed; the items are what the rest returned.

unreadable.description:
How many upstream entries could not be read and are missing from
`items`.

stale.description: `true` when the provider failed and the stored snapshot was served.

fetched_at.description: When the data was last fetched from the provider, if ever.

runtime_minutes.description: The film's runtime, or a show's typical episode runtime, in minutes.

release_status.description: The release status, as the provider words it.

in_production.description: Shows only: whether new episodes are still being made.

episode_count.description: `null` when the provider did not say.

Season.description: One season of a show. Specials are season 0.

rating.description: The provider's rating out of 10, when it has one.

Sort.description: The order of the library listing.

current_run_plays.description: Live plays in the current run.

current_run_episodes.description: Distinct episodes watched in the current run.

Progress.description:
How far the caller has got, derived from runs and plays (voided plays
never count).

added_at.description: When the title was first added.

deleted_at.description: When the entry went to the trash; `null` while it is in the library.

LibraryEntry.description: A title in the caller's library.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.

Precision.description: How precisely a date is known.

RunDate.description: A date and how precisely it is known.

completed.description: `null` while the run is under way, or when unknown.

WatchRun.description:
One watch-through of a title: run 1 is the first watch, later runs are
rewatches.

watched_at.description: When it was last watched in the run, if known.

WatchedEpisode.description: An episode watched in the current run.

watched.description: The episodes watched in the current run, by season then episode.

LibraryEntryDetail.description: A library entry with its runs and what the current run has watched.

EntryBody.description:
An entry to store: every member is set, and a member left out is cleared
(or `false`).

EntryChanges.description:
A change to an entry. A member left out is unchanged; `null` clears
`score` or `notes`.

started.description: When it started; today when left out.

RunChanges.description:
A change to a run's dates. A member left out is unchanged; `null` clears
it.

EpisodeNumber.description: One episode of a show, by number.

watched_at.description: When it was watched; now when left out.
When they were watched; now when left out.

oneOf.description: One play of each listed episode of a show, in order.

watched_at.description: When they were watched; unknown (`null`) when left out.

oneOf.description:
One play of every episode of the current run not yet watched, from
season 1 episode 1 up to and including this one. Specials (season 0)
are not included.

NewPlays.description: The plays to log, by kind.

run.description: The number of the run it belongs to.

watched_at.description: When it was watched; `null` when unknown.

voided_at.description: When it was undone; `null` while it counts.

Play.description: One recorded viewing of a movie or an episode.

plays.description: In the order logged; empty when every episode was already watched.

EntrySettings.description: An entry's own settings at one moment.

oneOf.description: The title was added to the library.
The entry went to the trash.
The entry came back from the trash.
A play was logged; `play` is as it was logged.

Change.description: What an event changed, by kind.

EntryEvent.description: One change to a library entry, from its append-only log.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.

HistoryEvent.description: An event in the caller's history, with the title it concerns.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.

name.description: `null` until the episode's details are known.

aired.description: Whether it has aired: `false` when its air date is later or unknown.

last_watched_at.description: When the caller last watched anything of the show.

UpNextItem.description: The next episode of a show the caller is watching.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.

watched.description: Whether the caller has watched it in the current run.

CalendarEpisode.description: An episode airing for a show in the caller's library.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.

The service can take traffic.

Metadata providers are reported and never make the service unready: the
library is served from the catalog snapshot while they are down.
